verses.original: Πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐξ ἀνθρώπων λαμβανόμενος ὑπὲρ ἀνθρώπων καθίσταται τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν ἵνα προσφέρῃ δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: Pas gar archiereus ex anthrōpōn lambanomenos hyper anthrōpōn kathistatai ta pros ton Theon hina prospherē dōra te kai thysias hyper hamartiōn
verses.literal: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins
verses.literalPt: PORQUE todo o sumo sacerdote, tomado dentre os homens, é constituído a favor dos homens nas coisas concernentes a Deus, para que ofereça dons e sacrifícios pelos pecados;

verses.original: μετριοπαθεῖν δυνάμενος τοῖς ἀγνοοῦσιν καὶ πλανωμένοις ἐπεὶ καὶ αὐτὸς περίκειται ἀσθένειαν
verses.transliteration: metriopathein dynamenos tois agnoousin kai planōmenois epei kai autos perikeitai astheneian
verses.literal: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided since he himself is subject to weakness
verses.literalPt: E possa compadecer-se ternamente dos ignorantes e errados; pois também ele mesmo está rodeado de fraqueza.

verses.original: καὶ δι’ αὐτὴν ὀφείλει καθὼς περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ οὕτως καὶ περὶ αὑτοῦ προσφέρειν περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: kai di’ autēn opheilei kathōs peri tou laou houtōs kai peri hautou prospherein peri hamartiōn
verses.literal: That is why . . . he is obligated to offer sacrifices - for his own sins as well as for the sins of the people
verses.literalPt: E por esta causa deve ele, tanto pelo povo, como também por si mesmo, fazer oferta pelos pecados.

verses.original: Καὶ οὐχ ἑαυτῷ τις λαμβάνει τὴν τιμήν ἀλλὰ καλούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ καθώσπερ καὶ Ἀαρών
verses.transliteration: Kai ouch heautō tis lambanei tēn timēn alla kaloumenos hypo tou Theou kathōsper kai Aarōn
verses.literal: No one takes this honor upon himself he must be called by God just as Aaron was
verses.literalPt: E ninguém toma para si esta honra, senão o que é chamado por Deus, como Arão.

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτὸν ἐδόξασεν γενηθῆναι ἀρχιερέα ἀλλ’ ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς αὐτόν Υἱός μου εἶ σύ ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai ho Christos ouch heauton edoxasen genēthēnai archierea all’ ho lalēsas pros auton Huios mou ei sy egō sēmeron gegennēka se
verses.literal: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory . . . of becoming a high priest but He was called by the One who said to Him You are My Son today I have become Your Father . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim também Cristo não se glorificou a si mesmo, para se fazer sumo sacerdote, mas aquele que lhe disse: Tu és meu Filho, Hoje te gerei.

verses.original: Καθὼς καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: Kathōs kai en heterō legei Sy hiereus eis ton aiōna kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: And . . . in another passage God says You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek
verses.literalPt: Como também diz, noutro lugar: Tu és sacerdote eternamente, Segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.

verses.original: Ὃς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ δεήσεις τε καὶ ἱκετηρίας πρὸς τὸν δυνάμενον σῴζειν αὐτὸν ἐκ θανάτου μετὰ κραυγῆς ἰσχυρᾶς καὶ δακρύων προσενέγκας καὶ εἰσακουσθεὶς ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλαβείας
verses.transliteration: Hos en tais hēmerais tēs sarkos autou deēseis te kai hiketērias pros ton dynamenon sōzein auton ek thanatou meta kraugēs ischyras kai dakryōn prosenenkas kai eisakoustheis apo tēs eulabeias
verses.literal: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death and He was heard because of His reverence
verses.literalPt: O qual, nos dias da sua carne, oferecendo, com grande clamor e lágrimas, orações e súplicas ao que o podia livrar da morte, foi ouvido quanto ao que temia.

verses.original: καίπερ ὢν Υἱός ἔμαθεν ἀφ’ ὧν ἔπαθεν τὴν ὑπακοήν
verses.transliteration: kaiper ōn Huios emathen aph’ hōn epathen tēn hypakoēn
verses.literal: Although He was a Son He learned obedience from what He suffered
verses.literalPt: Ainda que era Filho, aprendeu a obediência, por aquilo que padeceu.

verses.original: καὶ τελειωθεὶς ἐγένετο πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ αἴτιος σωτηρίας αἰωνίου
verses.transliteration: kai teleiōtheis egeneto pasin tois hypakouousin autō aitios sōtērias aiōniou
verses.literal: And having been made perfect He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
verses.literalPt: E, sendo ele consumado, veio a ser a causa da eterna salvação para todos os que lhe obedecem;

verses.original: προσαγορευθεὶς ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀρχιερεὺς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: prosagoreutheis hypo tou Theou archiereus kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek
verses.literalPt: Chamado por Deus sumo sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.

verses.original: Περὶ οὗ πολὺς ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος καὶ δυσερμήνευτος λέγειν ἐπεὶ νωθροὶ γεγόνατε ταῖς ἀκοαῖς
verses.transliteration: Peri hou polys hēmin ho logos kai dysermēneutos legein epei nōthroi gegonate tais akoais
verses.literal: We have much to say about this but it is hard to explain . . . because you are dull of hearing
verses.literalPt: Do qual muito temos que dizer, de difícil interpretação; porquanto vos fizestes negligentes para ouvir.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὀφείλοντες εἶναι διδάσκαλοι διὰ τὸν χρόνον πάλιν χρείαν ἔχετε τοῦ διδάσκειν ὑμᾶς τινα τὰ στοιχεῖα τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν λογίων τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ γεγόνατε χρείαν ἔχοντες γάλακτος καὶ οὐ στερεᾶς τροφῆς
verses.transliteration: kai gar opheilontes einai didaskaloi dia ton chronon palin chreian echete tou didaskein hymas tina ta stoicheia tēs archēs tōn logiōn tou Theou kai gegonate chreian echontes galaktos kai ou stereas trophēs
verses.literal: Although by this time you ought to be teachers you need someone to reteach . . . you the basic principles - of God’s word You need milk not solid food
verses.literalPt: Porque, devendo já ser mestres pelo tempo, ainda necessitais de que se vos torne a ensinar quais sejam os primeiros rudimentos das palavras de Deus; e vos haveis feito tais que necessitais de leite, e não de sólido mantimento.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ μετέχων γάλακτος ἄπειρος λόγου δικαιοσύνης νήπιος γάρ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: pas gar ho metechōn galaktos apeiros logou dikaiosynēs nēpios gar estin
verses.literal: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant inexperienced in the message of righteousness
verses.literalPt: Porque qualquer que ainda se alimenta de leite não está experimentado na palavra da justiça, porque é menino.

verses.original: τελείων δέ ἐστιν ἡ στερεὰ τροφή τῶν διὰ τὴν ἕξιν τὰ αἰσθητήρια γεγυμνασμένα ἐχόντων πρὸς διάκρισιν καλοῦ τε καὶ κακοῦ
verses.transliteration: teleiōn de estin hē sterea trophē tōn dia tēn hexin ta aisthētēria gegymnasmena echontōn pros diakrisin kalou te kai kakou
verses.literal: But solid food is for the mature who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish . . . good from evil
verses.literalPt: Mas o mantimento sólido é para os perfeitos, os quais, em razão do costume, têm os sentidos exercitados para discernir tanto o bem como o mal.
